completed: PHASE 4'S GATE IS CLOSED AND USER-VERIFIED. Fabio restarted the engine, ran Voice Changer end to end and confirmed on screen: a gallery card that STAYS, an audio player in the result pane, slots that keep their size when filled, and a RECORDED badge. On headphones: 'Voice sounds good. Good match.' First generation in this card's history that produced audible speech.

THE FIRST RUN LOOKED LIKE A SUCCESS AND WAS NOT - and I called it one before opening the file. No error, a gallery card, 'Generation finished', and an output of ONE SAMPLE (62 microseconds). 'No error' is not evidence a generation worked. Open the output.

ROOT CAUSE, OUTSIDE THIS REPO, PROVEN TWICE: setuptools 83 removed `pkg_resources`; `resemble-perth` still imports it, so `perth.perth_net` fails and `perth.PerthImplicitWatermarker` is None - but `import perth` SUCCEEDS, so Chatterbox's vc.py sets `PERTH_AVAILABLE = True` and calls `None()`. FL_ChatterboxVC catches EVERY exception and returns `torch.zeros((1, 2, 1))` @ 16 kHz, then reports success - bit-for-bit the file on disk (2ch, 1 sample, 16 kHz). Its `message` output carries the error and our graph does not wire it, so nothing surfaced in the app, the log or the console. Proof 1: the same graph with `message` wired to PreviewAny returned `An unexpected error occurred during VC: 'NoneType' object is not callable`. Proof 2: the model run offline with PERTH_AVAILABLE=False returned 118080 samples, 4.92 s, 24 kHz, peak 10555.

THE FIX IS `pip uninstall resemble-perth` IN THE ENGINE PYTHON, AND THE ENGINE MUST BE RESTARTED AFTER IT - `PERTH_AVAILABLE` is a module global read at import time, so the running process keeps the broken value. Verified the hard way: after the uninstall a fresh seed with node 4 uncached still failed, and only the restart fixed it. The pack's own requirements.txt keeps resemble-perth COMMENTED OUT ('Optional watermarking (may have Python 3.12+ compatibility issues)'), so a fresh engine never installs it; this machine carried it from an older pinned commit of ComfyUI_Fill-ChatterBox.

THE VANISHING GALLERY CARD WAS DATA LOSS, NOT A RENDER GLITCH, and the fix is generic. The card's <audio> could not decode the 1-sample flac, `media-missing` fired, and `removeGroup` deleted the entry from project.json while the media and sidecar stayed on disk. A decode failure and a deleted file raise the SAME `error` event, so any unplayable output silently deleted the only evidence of its own failure. Deletion now requires `/file-exists` to confirm the file is gone; the helper fails CLOSED (keeps the card) when the check cannot run, because the cost of being wrong there is deletion.

key_decisions: FABIO'S REVIEW CONVENTION: he names ONLY what he dislikes. Silence means approved. Misreading this cost session 18 an entire gate.

A MEASUREMENT IS NOT A PERCEPTUAL VERDICT - this card has paid for it nine times now. When his ear and a number disagree, the number is wrong until proven otherwise. The corollary bit this session in the other direction: 'no error' is not a measurement at all. A generation that reports success and writes a file can still have produced nothing - open the output before calling it done.

WHEN A USER GUESSES AT A CAUSE, CHECK IT RATHER THAN AGREEING. Twice on this card now: a 'stale app needing a restart' that was a real seed bug, and a 'probably normal, we never set up audio output' that was a real broken generation.

A THIRD-PARTY NODE THAT SWALLOWS EXCEPTIONS INTO AN UNWIRED OUTPUT IS INVISIBLE. FL_ChatterboxVC returns `(empty_audio, message)` on ANY exception and ComfyUI reports execution_success. When a node has a message/status output and the graph does not use it, that is where the error went - wire it to PreviewAny in a probe graph before assuming the model failed.

SAME GRAPH + SAME SEED = `execution_cached`, and a cached run proves NOTHING about a fix. One probe re-run this session returned the identical stale error with every node cached; change the seed to force real execution.
constraints: PEER SESSIONS ARE LIVE IN THIS TREE and commit to master. Commit by explicit pathspec, never `git add -A`. Left deliberately uncommitted: .claude/settings.local.json, dev_configs/smoke-run.txt, and the state/sessions/*.json churn.

HEREDOCS ARE BLOCKED by guard-shell, and so is a backslash-newline continuation. Write the commit message to a file and use `git commit -F <path>`; write multi-step shell or Python to a scratchpad file and run it by path.

`pip` COMMANDS AGAINST THE ENGINE PYTHON ARE REFUSED BY THE AUTO-MODE CLASSIFIER, not by the permission allowlist. Hand Fabio the command instead - and give it in POWERSHELL form with a leading `&` before the quoted exe path, or it dies with 'Unexpected token'.
ALWAYS take the GPU through gpu_lease.py, and stop asking permission per run - Fabio's standing position. Two graph probes and one offline model run went through it this session.
THE APP ENGINE IS ON 48188 (the standalone bench is 8188). `/history` and `/object_info` on 48188 are the ground truth for what a run actually did.

KILL YOUR OWN APP INSTANCE BY VERIFIED PID, never by name pattern: an agent instance and Fabio's live app share the byte-identical `electron.exe .` command line. His app owns :3000 - do not drive it, do not restart it.
